overloadMerges.note: command is documented as taking specific named constants from the 'QR Commands' constant theme (only these are supported); recorded as sentinelValues instead of a bare Integer.

sentinelValues.meaning: qr cmd generate - use of command QR RUN recommended instead

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Executes the toolbar button command identified by command (one of the qr cmd... constants), typically to programmatically trigger a command originally selected by the user and intercepted via QR ON COMMAND.

constraints: For generating a report, using the QR RUN command directly is recommended over passing qr cmd generate (2008) to this command.
